name: connectpak
description: Read-only access to 24 databases for AI agents over MCP: Postgres, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, MongoDB, Neo4j, Pinecone, and more. List schemas, describe tables, sample rows, and run guarded queries.

connection.title: Connection string
connection.description: DSN, URL, path, or key for your database, e.g. postgresql://reader:pw@host:5432/app. Use read-only credentials.

engine.title: Engine (only if not detected)
engine.description: Leave empty when the engine shows in the connection string. Required for: oracle, bigquery, dynamodb, elasticsearch, cassandra, memgraph, arangodb, pgvector, pinecone, weaviate, qdrant, chroma, milvus.
